Region = state, canton, prefecture, autonomous community...

variants.name: DefinedTerm
variants.definition: A word, name, acronym, phrase, etc. with a formal definition. Often used in the context of category or subject classification, glossaries or dictionaries, product or creative work types, etc. Use the name property for the term being defined, use termCode if the term has an alpha-numeric code allocated, use description to provide the definition of the term. Use the about property to specify what the term is about.

variants.name: DefinedTermSet
variants.definition: A set of defined terms, for example a set of categories or a classification scheme, a glossary, dictionary or enumeration. Use the about property to specify what the term set is about.

variants.name: displayLocation
variants.definition: The location at which an item can be viewed or experienced in-person.

variants.name: error
variants.definition: For failed actions, more information on the cause of the failure. Consider using the Error type.

variants.name: Error
variants.definition: Representation of an Error.

variants.name: errorCode
variants.definition: Application or platform dependant error code.

variants.name: genre
variants.definition: Genre of the creative work, broadcast channel or group.

variants.name: GraphicNovel
variants.definition:
This type is deprecated: GraphicNovel does not fit the BookFormatType enumeration, as it can appear in multiple formats (e.g., Hardcover, eBook). It is not mutually exclusive and therefore deprecated. Use standard BookFormatType values instead in combination with the SequentialArt.

Book format: GraphicNovel. May represent a bound collection of ComicIssue instances.

variants.name: Hardcover
variants.definition: A durable, archival-quality book featuring a rigid protective shell made of heavy board wrapped in cloth or paper, designed to withstand heavy use and preservation on a shelf.

variants.name: hasParticipationOffer
variants.definition: An offer to participate in the event, for example, Call for Proposals, Call for Speakers, or Call for Performers.

variants.name: hasSponsorshipOffer
variants.definition: An offer to sponsor the event, for example, Sponsorship Prospectus, Sponsorship Opportunities, or Sponsor Packages.

variants.name: healthPlanCostSharing
variants.definition: The costs to the patient for services under this network or formulary.

variants.name: InstantaneousEvent
variants.definition: An event with no duration, like for instance a computer log entry.

variants.name: lifeEvent
variants.definition: A life event like baptism, communions, Bar Mitzvahs, Aqiqah, Namakarana, Miyamairi, burial, ....

variants.name: LoginAction
variants.definition: The action of logging into a device or application.

variants.name: observationDate
variants.definition: The observationDate of an [[Observation]].

variants.name: operatingSystem
variants.definition: Operating systems supported (Windows 7, OS X 10.6, Android 1.6).

variants.name: OperatingSystem
variants.definition: System software that manages computer hardware and software resources, and provides common services for computer programs.

variants.name: OrderItem
variants.definition: An order item is a line of an order. It includes the quantity and shipping details of a bought offer.

variants.name: orderPercentage
variants.definition: Value in the range [0.0 ; 1.0] representing the fraction of the value of the order that is charged as shipping cost.

variants.name: owner
variants.definition: A person or organization who owns this Thing.

variants.name: owns
variants.definition: Things owned by the organization or person.

variants.name: Pamphlet
variants.definition: A small, unbound or stapled booklet consisting of few pages with a flexible paper cover, designed for the economical distribution of focused information on a single subject.

variants.name: Paperback
variants.definition: A flexible, lightweight book bound with a thick paper or cardstock cover and glued spine, prioritizing portability and affordability over long-term durability.

variants.name: PaymentMethod
variants.definition:
A payment method is a standardized procedure for transferring the monetary amount for a purchase. Payment methods are characterized by the legal and technical structures used, and by the organization or group carrying out the transaction. The following legacy values should be accepted: 

* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#ByBankTransferInAdvance
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#ByInvoice
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Cash
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#CheckInAdvance
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#COD
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#DirectDebit
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#GoogleCheckout
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#PayPal
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#PaySwarm

Structured values, or [UNCE payment means](https://vocabulary.uncefact.org/PaymentMeans) are recommended or for newer annotations.

variants.name: PerformingArtsEvent
variants.definition:
Live performance Event of the performing arts (music, theatre, dance, acrobatics, spoken word), including performance art and performative sports (e.g. choreographed forms of martial arts, figure skating, competitive ballroom dancing).

Note: Use additionalType to differentiate between productions / shows (PerformanceWork, EventSeries), tours (EventSeries), and individual performances.

variants.name: possibleTreatment
variants.definition: A possible treatment to address this condition, sign or symptom.

variants.name: priceComponent
variants.definition: This property links to all [[UnitPriceSpecification]] nodes that apply in parallel for the [[CompoundPriceSpecification]] node.

variants.name: priceType
variants.definition: Defines the type of a price specified for an offered product, for example a list price, a (temporary) sale price or a manufacturer suggested retail price. If multiple prices are specified for an offer the [[priceType]] property can be used to identify the type of each such specified price. The value of priceType can be specified as a value from enumeration PriceTypeEnumeration or, a UN/EDIFACT 5387 code, or as a free form text string for price types that are not already predefined in PriceTypeEnumeration.

variants.name: ResetPasswordAction
variants.definition: The action of resetting the password of a device or application.

variants.name: reviewAspect
variants.definition: This Review or Rating is relevant to this part or facet of the itemReviewed.

variants.name: runtimePlatform
variants.definition: Runtime platform or script interpreter dependencies (example: Java v1, Python 2.3, .NET Framework 3.0).

variants.name: RuntimePlatform
variants.definition: Specialized software environment that provides the essential infrastructure, libraries, and services required to execute a program.

variants.name: secondaryPrevention
variants.definition: A preventative therapy used to prevent reoccurrence of the medical condition after an initial episode of the condition.

variants.name: SequentialArt
variants.definition: An art forms that use images deployed in a specific order for the purpose of graphic storytelling (i.e., narration of graphic stories) or conveying information. Examples of SequentialArt are Franco-Belgian Bande Dessinée, Comics in the USA and 漫画 (Manga) in Japan.

variants.name: softwareRequirements
variants.definition: Component dependency requirements for application. This includes runtime environments and shared libraries that are not included in the application distribution package, but required to run the application (examples: DirectX, Java or .NET runtime).

variants.name: source
variants.definition: The source or cause of the event.

variants.name: timestamp
variants.definition: The instant the event occured.

variants.name: weightPercentage
variants.definition: Value in the range [0.0 ; 1.0] representing the fraction of the weight that is used to compute the shipping price.

variants.name: accessMode
variants.definition: The human sensory perceptual system or cognitive faculty through which a person may process or perceive the intellectual content of a resource, not including any adaptations of the content (e.g., text alternatives for images). Values should be drawn from the [approved vocabulary](https://www.w3.org/2021/a11y-discov-vocab/latest/#accessMode-vocabulary).

variants.name: accessModeSufficient
variants.definition: A list of single or combined access modes that are sufficient to understand all the intellectual content of a resource, including any adaptations. Values should be drawn from the [approved vocabulary](https://www.w3.org/2021/a11y-discov-vocab/latest/#accessModeSufficient-vocabulary).

variants.name: addressRegion
variants.definition: The region in which the locality is, and which is in the country. For example, California or another appropriate first-level [Administrative division](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_administrative_divisions_by_country) such as the Province in Italy or Region in Germany.

variants.name: associatedClaimReview
variants.definition: An associated [[ClaimReview]], related by specific common content, topic or claim. The expectation is that this property would be most typically used in cases where a single activity is conducting both claim reviews and media reviews, in which case [[relatedMediaReview]] would commonly be used on a [[ClaimReview]], while [[associatedClaimReview]] would be used on [[MediaReview]].

variants.name: associatedMediaReview
variants.definition: An associated [[MediaReview]], related by specific common content, topic or claim. The expectation is that this property would be most typically used in cases where a single activity is conducting both claim reviews and media reviews, in which case [[relatedMediaReview]] would commonly be used on a [[ClaimReview]], while [[associatedClaimReview]] would be used on [[MediaReview]].

variants.name: companyRegistration
variants.definition: The official registration information of a business including the organization that issued it such as Company House or Chamber of Commerce in form of a Certification.

variants.name: Credential
variants.definition: A credential is a certificate that is used to verify the identity of a person or entity.

variants.name: credentialCategory
variants.definition: The category or type of credential being described, for example "degree”, “certificate”, “badge”, or more specific term.

variants.name: DECooperativeCharity
variants.definition: DECooperativeCharity: Non-profit type referring to a charitable Cooperative (German Genossenschaft) that has been recognized by the tax authorities as a charitable non-profit.

variants.name: DEFoundationCharity
variants.definition: DEFoundationCharity: Non-profit type referring to a charitable Foundation (German Stiftung) that has been recognized by the tax authorities as a charitable non-profit.

variants.name: DEJointStockCompanyCharity
variants.definition: DEJointStockCompanyCharity: Non-profit type referring to a charitable Joint Stock Company (German gAG gemeinnützige Aktiengesellschaft) that has been recognized by the tax authorities as a charitable non-profit.

variants.name: DELimitedLiabilityCharity
variants.definition: DELimitedLiabilityCharity: Non-profit type referring to a charitable Common Stock Company (German gGmbH or gemeinnützige Gesellschaft mit beschränkter Haftung) that has been recognized by the tax authorities as a charitable non-profit.

variants.name: DENonprofitType
variants.definition: DENonprofitType: Non-profit organization type originating from Germany in accordance with article 52 of the German fiscal code (Abgabenverordnung or AO).

variants.name: DENotRegisteredAssociationCharity
variants.definition: DENotRegisteredAssociationCharity: Non-profit type referring to a charitable association that is not registered with the German association register (gemeinnütziger Verein) and has been recognized by the tax authorities as a charitable non-profit.

variants.name: DEPublicCharity
variants.definition: DEPublicCharity: Non-profit type referring to a charitable government owned juridical person (German Körperschaft öffentlichen Rechts) that has been recognized by the tax authorities as a charitable non-profit.

variants.name: DERegisteredAssociationCharity
variants.definition: DERegisteredAssociationCharity: Non-profit type referring to a charitable association that is registered with the German association register (german gemeinnütziger e.v. or gemeinnütziger eingetragener Verein) and has been recognized by the tax authorities as a charitable non-profit.

variants.name: EducationalOccupationalCredential
variants.definition: An educational or occupational credential. A diploma, academic degree, certification, qualification, badge, etc., that may be awarded to a person or other entity that meets the requirements defined by the credentialer.

variants.name: floorLevel
variants.definition:
The floor level for an [[Accommodation]] in a multi-storey building. Since counting
  systems [vary internationally](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Storey#Consecutive_number_floor_designations), the local system should be used where possible.

variants.name: hasCredential
variants.definition: A credential awarded to the Person or Organization.

variants.name: hasGS1DigitalLink
variants.definition:
The GS1 digital link associated with the object. This URL should conform to the particular requirements of digital links. The link should only contain the Application Identifiers (AIs) that are relevant for the entity being annotated, for instance a [[Product]] or an [[Organization]], and for the correct granularity. In particular, for products:
  • A Digital Link that contains a serial number (AI 21) should only be present on instances of [[IndividualProduct]]
  • A Digital Link that contains a lot number (AI 10) should be annotated as [[SomeProducts]] if only products from that lot are sold, or [[IndividualProduct]] if there is only a specific product.
  • A Digital Link that contains a global model number (AI 8013) should be attached to a [[Product]] or a [[ProductModel]].
Other item types should be adapted similarly.

variants.name: incentiveAmount
variants.definition:
Describes the amount that can be redeemed from this incentive.

[[QuantitativeValue]]: Use this for incentives based on price (either raw amount or percentage-based). For a raw amount example, "You can claim $2,500 - $7,500 from the total cost of installation" would be represented as the following:

{ "@type": "QuantitativeValue", “minValue”: 2500, “maxValue”: 7500, "unitCode": "USD" }

[[QuantitativeValue]] can also be used for percentage amounts. In such cases, value is used to represent the incentive’s percentage, while maxValue represents a limit (if one exists) to that incentive. The unitCode should be 'P1' and the unitText should be '%', while valueReference should be used for holding the currency type. For example, "You can claim up to 30% of the total cost of installation, up to a maximum of $7,500" would be:

{ "@type": "QuantitativeValue", "value": 30, "unitCode": "P1", "unitText": "%", “maxValue”: 7500, “valueReference”: “USD” }

[[UnitPriceSpecification]]: Use this for incentives that are based on amounts rather than price. For example, a net metering rebate that pays $10/kWh, up to $1,000:

{ "@type": "UnitPriceSpecification", "price": 10, "priceCurrency": "USD", "referenceQuantity": 1, "unitCode": "DO3", "unitText": "kw/h", "maxPrice": 1000, "description": "$10 / kwh up to $1000" }

[[LoanOrCredit]]: Use for incentives that are loan based. For example, a loan of $4,000 - $50,000 with a repayment term of 10 years, interest free would look like:

{ "@type": "LoanOrCredit", "loanTerm": { "@type":"QuantitativeValue", "value":"10", "unitCode": "ANN" }, "amount":[ { "@type": "QuantitativeValue", "Name":"fixed interest rate", "value":"0", }, ], "amount":[ { "@type": "MonetaryAmount", "Name":"min loan amount", "value":"4000", "currency":"CAD" }, { "@type": "MonetaryAmount", "Name":"max loan amount", "value":"50000", "currency":"CAD" } ], } In summary:
  • Use [[QuantitativeValue]] for absolute/percentage-based incentives applied on the price of a good/service.
  • Use [[UnitPriceSpecification]] for incentives based on a per-unit basis (e.g. net metering).
  • Use [[LoanOrCredit]] for loans/credits.
.

variants.name: ITCooperativeCharity
variants.definition: ITCooperativeCharity: Non-profit type referring to Cooperatives with charitable missions (Ital. Cooperativa Sociale) according to Italian Law 112 of 2017.

variants.name: ITMutualAidCharity
variants.definition: ITMutualAidCharity: Non-profit type referring to associations providing financial aid to people need (Ital. Società di mutuo soccorso or SOMS) according to Italian Law 3818 of 1886.

variants.name: ITNonprofitType
variants.definition: ITNonprofitType: Non-profit organization type originating from Italy.

variants.name: ITSocialCompanyCharity
variants.definition: ITSocialCompanyCharity: Non-profit type referring to companies with charitable missions (Ital. Imprese Sociali or IS) according to Italian Law 112 of 2017.

variants.name: ITSocialPromotionCharity
variants.definition: ITSocialPromotionCharity: Non-profit type referring to associations promoting charitable causes (Ital. Associazioni di promozione sociale or APS) according to Italian Law 383 of 2000.

variants.name: ITSportCompanyCharity
variants.definition: ITSportCompanyCharity: Non-profit type referring to Companies that organize sports activities for the public or inscribed members (Ital. Società Sportiva Dilettantistica or SSD) according to Italian Law 289 of 2002.

variants.name: ITVolunteerAssociationCharity
variants.definition: ITVolunteerAssociationCharity: Non-profit type referring to associations organising charitable volunteer activities (Ital. Organizzazioni di volontariato or ODV) according to Italian Law 266 of 1991.

variants.name: jobDuration
variants.definition: The expected duration of an employment offer as advertised by the employer. Relevant for job postings that have a clearly defined period in mind such as seasonal work, substitutes for maternal leave or any other temporary employment.

variants.name: measurementTechnique
variants.definition:
A technique, method or technology used in an [[Observation]], [[StatisticalVariable]] or [[Dataset]] (or [[DataDownload]], [[DataCatalog]]), corresponding to the method used for measuring the corresponding variable(s) (for datasets, described using [[variableMeasured]]; for [[Observation]], a [[StatisticalVariable]]). Often but not necessarily each [[variableMeasured]] will have an explicit representation as (or mapping to) an property such as those defined in Schema.org, or other RDF vocabularies and "knowledge graphs". In that case the subproperty of [[variableMeasured]] called [[measuredProperty]] is applicable.
    
The [[measurementTechnique]] property helps when extra clarification is needed about how a [[measuredProperty]] was measured. This is oriented towards scientific and scholarly dataset publication but may have broader applicability; it is not intended as a full representation of measurement, but can often serve as a high level summary for dataset discovery. 

For example, if [[variableMeasured]] is: molecule concentration, [[measurementTechnique]] could be: "mass spectrometry" or "nmr spectroscopy" or "colorimetry" or "immunofluorescence". If the [[variableMeasured]] is "depression rating", the [[measurementTechnique]] could be "Zung Scale" or "HAM-D" or "Beck Depression Inventory". 

If there are several [[variableMeasured]] properties recorded for some given data object, use a [[PropertyValue]] for each [[variableMeasured]] and attach the corresponding [[measurementTechnique]]. The value can also be from an enumeration, organized as a [[MeasurementMethodEnum]].

variants.name: orderPercentage
variants.definition: Value representing the fraction of the value of the order that is charged as shipping cost. Example: 0.10 would mean shipping rate is 10% of the total order value.

variants.name: previousStartDate
variants.definition: Used in conjunction with eventStatus for rescheduled or cancelled events. This property contains the previously scheduled start date. For rescheduled events, the startDate property should be used for the newly scheduled start date. In the (rare) case of an event that has been postponed and rescheduled multiple times, this field may be repeated.

variants.name: qualifications
variants.definition: Specific qualifications required for this role or Occupation.

variants.name: Quantity
variants.definition: Quantities such as distance, time, mass, weight, etc. Particular instances of say Mass are strings like '3 kg' or '4 milligrams'.

variants.name: recognizedBy
variants.definition: An organization that acknowledges the validity, value or utility of a credential. Note: recognition may include a process of quality assurance or accreditation.

variants.name: suitableForDiet
variants.definition: Indicates a dietary restriction or guideline for which this recipe or menu item is suitable, e.g. diabetic, halal etc.

variants.name: validFor
variants.definition: The duration of validity of a permit or similar thing.

variants.name: validForMemberTier
variants.definition: The membership program tier(s) an Offer (or a PriceSpecification, OfferShippingDetails, or MerchantReturnPolicy under an Offer) is valid for.

variants.name: validIn
variants.definition: The geographic area where the item is valid. Applies for example to a [[Permit]], a [[Certification]], or an [[EducationalOccupationalCredential]].

variants.name: vatID
variants.definition: The value-added Tax ID of the organization or person with national prefix (for example IT123456789). Can also be described as [[iso6523Code]] with proper prefix.

variants.name: weightPercentage
variants.definition: Value representing the fraction of the weight that is used to compute the shipping price. Example: 0.10 and a shipping weight of 15kg would add $1.5 to the order price, where the $ is the currency of the order.
